faqs.question: Will this work with my mouse?
faqs.answer: Yes. The smooth surface works with optical and laser mice, wired or wireless, from any brand.

faqs.question: Will it slip on my desk?
faqs.answer: The rubber base grips the desk so the pad stays in place during normal use. It grips best on a clean, dry surface.

faqs.question: Can I check the size before ordering?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send us a message on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the size and send a photo before you order.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this mouse pad?
faqs.answer: This mouse pad comes with a warranty — message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
